# Northgate Rail: timetable data session

**Date:** Wednesday 23 September 2026

###### 00:00 - 00:19
**Hannah Cleave**

Tobias, I will get you the timetable extract by Friday so you can run the comparison.

###### 00:19 - 00:36
**Tobias Renn**

Thanks. I will feed the results back to your planning team next week.

###### 00:36 - 00:58
**Dom Selvon**

Useful to hear. I will stay out of that loop and pick things up once you have compared them.

###### 00:58 - 01:10
**Hannah Cleave**

That is the right order.
notes: Both promises are between two people at the counterparty. Nothing is owed to or by Dom.
